Extract bare (no @) citekey-shaped tokens from a text/data file

Source: R/keys.R
cz_bare_keys.Rd

For files that reference sources informally (e.g. a CSV "comments" column saying "defined in Dubuisson2013a"). Matches an author-shaped run of letters (hyphens allowed) immediately followed by a 19xx/20xx year and an optional lowercase disambiguator, e.g. Ebihara2006, Boucheron-Dubuisson2024. Deliberately conservative: Ebihara 2006 or Hsu7949 do not match.

Usage

cz_bare_keys(path)

Arguments

path

Path to the file to scan.

Value

Sorted character vector of unique citekey-shaped tokens.

Examples

notes <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
writeLines(c("site,comment", "A,defined in Darwin1859", "B,see Ebihara 2006"), notes)
cz_bare_keys(notes) # "Ebihara 2006" does not match
#> character(0)
